description: This file manages agent file state, including loading, editing, and saving agent files via client requests, with functions for merging entries and handling file content and drafts.

methods.name: mergeFileEntry
methods.description: Merges an agent file entry into the list, updating existing entries or adding new ones.

methods.name: loadAgentFiles
methods.description: Loads the list of agent files for a given agent ID, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: loadAgentFileContent
methods.description: Loads the content of a specific agent file, updating state and optionally preserving drafts.

methods.name: saveAgentFile
methods.description: Saves the content of an agent file to the server and updates local state.
